description: Na₂BeF₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one BeF₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with three equivalent BeF₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-69°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent BeF₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one BeF₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.42 Å. Be is bonded to four F atoms to form BeF₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaF₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-50°. There are a spread of Be-F bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to four Na and one Be atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₄Be trigonal bipyramids. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Be atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Be atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Be atom.
